message.content:
Based on my search, here are the login portals for PreLicenseTraining:

## Main Student Login
**https://prelicensetraining.com/login**

This is the primary login page for students. You will need to enter your login name and password. (Tip: Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration.)

## Mentor/Recruiter Login
There are separate login portals for mentors, recruiters, and company accounts:

- **PSI Online Mentor Login:** https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- **Infinity Schools Mentor Login:** https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

## Password Recovery
If you've forgotten your password, you can use the forgot password feature at:
- **https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword**

---

**About PreLicenseTraining.com:** The platform provides insurance pre-licensing and continuing education with online textbooks, audio, streaming video instruction, practice exams, and a virtual testing center called StudyHall. They have helped over 150,000 individuals obtain their insurance licenses.

If you are a student trying to log in, make sure you're using the main student login at prelicensetraining.com/login rather than the mentor portals.

Sources:
1. https://prelicensetraining.com/login
2. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
3. https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
4. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
